string.comment: This is shown in the custom game screen. Will open the game lobby.

string.name: feedbackButton
string.comment: Shown in the settings, pressing this button will redirect to the lichess contact site.

string.name: goodEvening
string.comment: A greeting that is shown on the app's home page, e.g. 'Good evening, GM Magnus' (%s is substituted with the user's name). This is associated with a 'moon' icon and is displayed only between 18:00 and 06:00 local time. If the language you're translating into does not have this time based concept, just use a generic formula (like 'Hello' in english).

string.name: goodEveningWithoutName
string.comment: A greeting that is shown on the app's home page, when the user is not logged in. This is associated with a 'moon' icon and is displayed only between 18:00 and 06:00 local time. If the language you're translating into does not have this time based concept, just use a generic formula (like 'Hello' in english).

string.name: goodDay
string.comment: A greeting that is shown on the app's home page, e.g. 'Good day, GM Magnus' (%s is substituted with the user's name). This is associated with a 'sun' icon and is displayed only between 06:00 and 18:00 local time. If the language you're translating into does not have this time based concept, just use a generic formula (like 'Hello' in english).

string.name: goodDayWithoutName
string.comment: A greeting that is shown on the app's home page, when the user is not logged in. This is associated with a 'sun' icon and is displayed only between 06:00 and 18:00 local time. If the language you're translating into does not have this time based concept, just use a generic formula (like 'Hello' in english).

resources.string: Solve as many puzzles as possible in 3 minutes.

string.comment: Shown as a subtitle in the confirmation dialog for aborting puzzle streak. Prefer to not translate Puzzle Streak

string.comment: Shown as a description for the 'Puzzle themes' mode

resources.string: Play puzzles from your favorite openings, or choose a theme.

string.name: recentSearches
string.comment: Title of the recent searches section in the search screen.

string.comment: Title of a switch in analysis settings, used to toggle the server analysis display.

string.comment: Dragged target settings square type. One of the possible values of 'Dragged piece target' settings.

string.comment: Displayed in theme background choice screen, to show the board when viewing chosen image.

string.name: settingsPickAnImageSwipeToDisplay

string.name: settingsPieceShiftMethodEither

string.name: settingsPieceShiftMethodTapTwoSquares
string.comment: A value of piece shift method settings entry.

string.name: settingsShapeDrawing
string.comment: Entry in the settings.

string.name: settingsShapeDrawingSubtitle
string.comment: Help message for the 'Shape drawing' settings entry.

resources.string: Draw shapes using two fingers: maintain one finger on an empty square and drag another finger to draw a shape.

string.name: settingsShowBorder
string.comment: Settings found in theme screen. If enabled a border will be shown around the board.

string.comment: Entry in the settings. When enabled, the app will vibrate on some game events like move and capture.

string.name: settingsTouchFeedbackSubtitle
string.comment: Help message for the touch feedback settings entry in main settings screen.

resources.string: When enabled, the device will vibrate shortly when you move or capture a piece.

string.name: showComments

string.name: showVariations
string.comment: Shown in the analysis screen.

string.name: somethingWentWrong

string.name: theme
string.comment: Graphic theme section in the global app settings.

string.name: toolsTab
string.comment: The tab in bottom navigation bar. Must be very short (10 characters max) to avoid ugly text shifting issues. Currently this includes the analysis board, the chess clock, and importing a position by PGN/FEN

string.comment: Shown when trying to access/play a variant not yet supported in the app.

string.name: waitingForOpponentToJoin
